REVIEW_TEXT: Eggs Benedict were the best I've had in San Francisco. Eggs were poached just right -- not runny nor rubbery -- made me wish there were 3 eggs. Also, Canadian Bacon, not sliced ham, was used. (Some Old School dishes are made for a reason). Their Hollandaise was the BEST: Just the right amount of lemony tang. And the Home Fries were eXcellent, made the way they were when I was growing up -- with chopped onions added for a delicate flavor.  My only complaint was that the Breakfast Burrito had no cheese -- or if it did, I couldn't find it. I count on the cheese not only for flavor, but to bind the eggs and potatoes together inside the tortilla. All in all, a delicious memory. I look forward to ordering from JB's Place again.

This is the best rendition of a crab rangoon I've ever had. I am very serious about rangoons. These are so fresh, you are one fry away from the hands that wrapped the cream and crab. Ridiculously bright. Crispy as hell. This is my second time trying these-just as perfect. You get 3 lovely servings. They are large.  And of course, it comes with a swest chili dipping sauce. Now, the chow mein. I got chicken. Very delicous, very fresh, flavor is there. The noodles? Lovely. Silky. Chewy. Will I order these again? Not for a long time, only because I am going to come back and try every single dish. One day? Yes. Soon? No. 

Thank you Dumpling Union for the lovely food.

REVIEW_TEXT: I have a friend from Myanmar who recently I asked to teach me about the culture and history, as I knew almost nothing about it. Then I got curious about food and it led me here, and thank god. The flavors are so well paired and unlike anything else, and the quality is great. The Spicy & Crispy Chicken was still very crisp, the Mixed Vegetables Curry and Burmese Garlic Noodles had unique flavors that blended so well. The Coconut Rice had all the coconut flavor I could ask for and I was shocked at how well it goes with fried onion. It is on the expensive side, but you'll understand why once you try it and the portions are filling. Burmese food is now in my top three cuisines and I will be ordering again!!🇲🇲
